patch.summary: Hive migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Hive by inventorying legacy project-management fields, mapping them to Hive objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams
Success signal: task boards works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Hive migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power task boards, timeline / Gantt, workload and resources and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Hive; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Slack; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SMB and mid-market teams wanting Work OS depth with a lower paid entry than monday outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams
If Hive mapping is poor, compare destination fit with monday.com before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Slack in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Flexible add-ons (~list price) can raise TCO beyond the Teams floor

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for task boards
Mitigate: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
